description: Returns the curated list of places where the Targumim (the Aramaic translations of the Torah and Isaiah) and the New Testament share an idea, phrase or contrast. Each entry has a title, whether it is a shared idea or a contrast, the Targum passages, the New Testament passages, and a note saying what is and is not claimed. The whole list comes back in one piece; it takes no filter. Use when the user asks where Targum wording and the New Testament overlap.

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_targum_connections
title: Targum connections
